title: Shopping Basket
story: Chilaka's basket needs three changes before heading home.
goal: Starting from basket = ["rice", "dal"], add "oil", remove "rice", then sort the list.
starter:
basket = ["rice", "dal"]
# add "oil", remove "rice", then sort the list
hints: Lists have methods: append adds to the end, remove deletes a value, sort puts items in order.
Do them in order: append("oil"), remove("rice"), sort().
socratic: Which method adds to the end?
What does sort() do to the list?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what is the key idea in “Shopping Basket”?
